mapper.select: select version, `id` as versionId from bm_batch_record_version where record_id =#{recordId} and is_deleted = 0 and state in ('3','4') order by create_time asc

SELECT t1.NAME as version, t1.id as versionId FROM bm_batch_record AS t1 JOIN bm_batch_record_product AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.record_id WHERE t1.is_deleted = 0 AND t2.is_deleted = 0 AND t2.product_id =#{productId}

SELECT t1.`name` as name, t1.`code` as code, t2.id as versionId, t2.record_id as recordId, t2.version as version, t2.remark as remark, t2.create_by as createBy, t2.instance_id as processInstanceId FROM bm_batch_record AS t1 JOIN bm_batch_record_version AS t2 on t1.id = t2.record_id where t1.is_deleted = 0 and t2.is_deleted = 0 and t2.state = 2
and t1.`name` like concat('%',#{recordName},'%')
and t1.`code` like concat('%',#{recordCode},'%')
SELECT `name` FROM bm_batch_record WHERE is_deleted = 0 and id=#{recordId}
SELECT `code` FROM bm_batch_record WHERE is_deleted = 0 and id=#{recordId}

SELECT DISTINCT t3.id FROM bm_batch_record AS t1 JOIN lm_resource_permission t2 ON t1.id = t2.resource_id JOIN bm_batch_record_version AS t3 ON t1.id = t3.record_id WHERE t1.is_deleted = 0 AND t3.is_deleted = 0 AND t3.state = '2' and t2.dept_id in
#{item}

SELECT CONCAT(t1.`name`,'-',t2.version) as recordName, t2.version, t2.is_deleted as deleted, t2.state FROM bm_batch_record AS t1 JOIN bm_batch_record_version AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.record_id where t2. id in
#{id}

SELECT CONCAT(t1.`name`,'-',t2.version) as recordName, t2.version, t2.is_deleted as deleted, t2.state, t2.record_id, t1.`name` as name FROM bm_batch_record AS t1 JOIN bm_batch_record_version AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.record_id where t2. id =#{id}
